items.text: Minnesota QB: Kyler Murray (hamstring) will not play Monday and is week-to-week; Carson Wentz starts, Max Brosmer backup (per HC Kevin O'Connell, Thursday).
Minnesota (TBD, first report Thursday): LT Christian Darrisaw (shoulder), S Theo Jackson (quad). G Donovan Jackson (meniscus) out for regular season; TE Josh Oliver (season), C Nick Samac on IR.
Buffalo (TBD): WR DJ Moore (knee/AC joint), WR Joshua Palmer (hamstring), RT Spencer Brown (back). S C.J. Gardner-Johnson suspended; WR Tyrell Shavers (ACL, PUP).
